intro: Tuesday brings changes to open-model hosting, coding-agent controls and security scans. Highway work affects Horseshoe Bay travel, BC prepares an alert test, and December planning offers choral music, agent building and seasonal dining.

stories.title: Hugging Face moves language-model routing to OpenRouter
stories.summary: Hugging Face now routes language-model requests through OpenRouter, selecting providers using price, speed and reliability. Existing API code remains compatible, but custom provider keys no longer work for language models; requests are billed through Hugging Face.

stories.title: Copilot adds controls over customization sources
stories.summary: Enterprise administrators can restrict where Copilot customizations originate, covering skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers and executable extensions. Managed settings and plugins give organizations a way to distribute approved tools while controlling additions from other sources.

stories.title: VS Code sets February retirement for its older agent runtime
stories.summary: VS Code 1.146 deprecates the Local harness, with removal scheduled for February 2027. Its replacement already handles new sessions by default; administrators should check customization compatibility, runtime permissions and sandbox settings before the transition.

stories.title: GitHub adds batch launches for repository AI scans
stories.summary: GitHub’s public preview can start AI security scans across as many as 20 repositories at once. Findings join the code-scanning backlog alongside CodeQL alerts, including issues in languages CodeQL does not support; a Copilot licence is not required.

stories.title: BC schedules Wednesday’s emergency alert test
stories.summary: BC will test emergency notifications Wednesday, November 18, at 1:55 p.m. Pacific, reaching compatible cellphones and interrupting television and radio. The message will identify itself as a test and requires no public action.

stories.title: Macklem will leave when his term ends next June
stories.summary: Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem will not seek a second term when his seven-year appointment expires June 2, 2027. The board has begun searching for his successor, with recruitment expected to finish by spring.

markets.change: 2026-11-16 monthly CPI release: October inflation matched September’s 3.1% annual increase. Source: https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/daily-quotidien/261116/dq261116a-eng.htm

markets.value: 6% of surveyed firms planning or budgeting for recession

events.date: 2026-12-13 · 2:30 p.m. · Pacific Spirit United Church, 2195 West 45th Avenue, Vancouver
events.title: Chantez Noël pairs Bach with audience carols
events.description: Pacific Spirit’s chamber choir, organist Edward Norman and chamber players perform Bach’s Christmas Cantata BWV 147 alongside seasonal works and audience singing. General admission is $30; children and students enter free, with tickets online and at the door.

meetups.date: 2026-12-05 · 9 a.m.–7 p.m. · Unit 400, 322 Water Street, Vancouver
meetups.title: Agent-building competition turns business problems into demos
meetups.description: Cognition and Keiki invite builders to develop a custom agent using Devin and Keiki, then present a working demonstration. Registration requires host approval; the day includes focused building time, project demonstrations, judging and a closing awards session.

dining.date: 2026-11-18 through 2026-12-18 · Showcase Restaurant & Bar, 1122 West Hastings Street, Vancouver
dining.title: Showcase starts its weekday holiday lunch buffet
dining.description: The seasonal buffet returns Wednesday through Friday with roast turkey, honey-garlic ham, maple butter tarts and peppermint mousse cake. It costs $55 per person including select beverages, with an automatic 18% gratuity; reservations are available through the restaurant.
